<Heading

  children={"List the staffing gap for every path planned within one committed shift plan of a site (canonical route)"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/sites/{siteCode}/shifts/{shiftId}/staffing-gap"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The canonical route of the all-paths staffing-gap list (ADR 0035; supersedes GET /buildings/\{buildingId\}/shifts/\{shiftId\}/staffing-gap, which stays as a deprecated alias). Same handler core and response shape. The path siteCode is both the plan lookup key and the associate scope: every path's activeHeads counts only associates with an active shift at that site (ADR 0034). Reuses the exact same per-path computation as GET /paths/\{pathId\}/staffing-gap and raises PathUnderstaffed for every understaffed path in the plan. This surfaces the gaps only — it never decides or performs a rebalance; that stays a human call recorded via POST /associates/\{id\}/assignments.

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"siteCode","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The canonical Site code (the facility-layout Site code, e.g. WH1). It is both the plan lookup key AND the associate scope: activeHeads counts only assignments whose associate has an active (not-ended) shift at that site (ADR 0034, ADR 0035). The key is the resource identity and is used exactly as given (never trimmed); it is not required to be a canonical facility-layout code, because plans written under a legacy buildingId are read here too (ADR 0035). It is never validated against facility-layout: a key with no plan is 404.","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"example":"WH1"},{"name":"shiftId","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The shift (within the site) whose committed plan to read.","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"example":"shift-1"},{"name":"limit","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Page size, 1-500 (default 100). Empty or repeated is 400 invalid-limit.","schema":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":500,"default":100}},{"name":"cursor","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Opaque page token from the previous page's nextCursor; repeat the same filters.
